scope: Direct pre-release C++ method/name codec replacement; supersedes legacy-preservation assumptions in adoption-cpp-audit.json. Production code unchanged by this audit.
policy: One new codec for current method/action/event/reflected-name identifiers; account encoding stays separate. No old-ID persistence/decoding requirement.

implementation_choice.recommended: Canonical ActionName/action_name type and a mechanical in-tree MethodNumber rename; replace common method_to_number/number_to_method/hash classification. Actions and events share the new encoding.
implementation_choice.optional_smallest_diff: A source-only MethodNumber alias can temporarily point at ActionName; this is one encoder and no legacy decoder. It can be omitted for cleaner APIs.

estimates_not_measured_patch.generated_model_data: Track bytes separately; no handwritten LOC estimate.

critical_shared_paths: get_type_name.hpp hash_name and is_compressed_name delegate to method codec
reflect.hpp named field and method lookups share hash_name; update both consistently
Numeric field/member indexes are separate from named hashes
schema.hpp ActionMap and EventMap share CompareMethodNumber; shared replacement can keep that structure
Actor.hpp generated action IDs and event IDs derive MethodNumber centrally
additional_python_integration_test_copy: programs/psinode/tests/name.py contains another old method codec; replace with shared frozen reference/generated goldens and refresh hardcoded test_name.py IDs.
boundary_decision: Default raw u64 zero sentinel exists today; specify null/default representation separately from strict parsing of actual identifiers rather than accidentally letting string validation choose object-default semantics.

chosen_small_diff_plan.source_only_alias: MethodNumber may alias ActionName to reduce unrelated source churn; no second numeric format or decoder

python_test_helper_scope.recommendation: Replace Python method arithmetic copy with shared new reference/generated vectors; retain independent enumerative account helpers.
